title: Delete Form Request
description: Schema for deleting a form record

record_id.description: The ID of the record to delete

page_id.description: The ID of the page containing the form

section_id.description: The section ID of the form, or of the entry list the record belongs to

expected_version.description: Required: the record version the delete is based on (the `version` the client last received from the record or from the list). A delete that names none, or a value that is not a whole number of at least 1, is refused with 400 (`expected_version_required` / `invalid_expected_version`); one based on an older version is refused with 409 (`stale_version`). Nothing is deleted by a refused request. The schema declares it optional only so that the refusal carries its reason.

preview.description: Act on the draft of the page instead of its published version. Only for a signed-in person who may read the draft; it must match what the person is looking at (the page endpoint's `preview`). Without it the published version is used. The page access rights, the live data and the permissions stay the same.
